examples.name: Counter-sample — wood
paragraphs: The region bands (AFRICA, AUSTRALIA, NORTH AMERICA) are visually identical grey bold bands. A rendering that tags one of them as a body cell and another as <th> in the same document violates the one-form-per-document requirement. The conforming rendering uses one form — here the preferred bold <td> — for every band in both tables.

It is the stub header, in the header row, and there is no caption. The SOUTHERN AND EASTERN EUROPE heading above the frame would make sense without the table, so it stays a heading; the (1) note below the frame follows the table.
